# Package name

<!-- Copy to packages/<id>/README.md. Replace the prompts below with verified instructions, then remove the comments and any sections that do not apply. A simple agent can keep its whole guide here; larger apps should link focused topic guides. -->

Describe what the package does and when someone would use it.

## Before you start

List supported modes, Engine requirements and anything users need to configure, such as a connection, external service or hardware. State important limitations.

## Install and open

Explain how to find the package in **Agents → Download Agents** and what to do after installation. Name the actual Home tab or chat settings path. Say whether a restart is required.

## Try it

Give a short sequence for one useful task. Use the actual UI labels and describe the result users can check.

## Settings

Explain the choices users commonly need, where to find them and how they affect the result. Link a separate settings guide if the package needs one.

## When something goes wrong

Describe common symptoms and the steps users can take. Include any relevant data retention, reset or uninstall behavior before recommending actions that remove data.

## More help

Link existing topic guides with descriptive labels. Use relative paths to Markdown files and include a link back to this README in each topic. Remove this section if the README is the whole guide.
